thread:
rachel: Noticed spike in SCIM PATCH failures for tenant 'Helios' — many 422/BadRequest with 'invalid encrypted_extid' and some SSO logins failing with SAML.CERT_EXPIRED.
omar: Times? correlation id?
rachel: Started ~2026-03-20T13:05Z. sample req id req_aa12.
kms-bot: [13:06:12] kms.decrypt failure key=helios-extid reason=EnvelopeVersionMismatch request=req_aa12
kira: Cert expired — did Helios rotate their IdP certs? Could be clock skew.
omar: I pulled their metadata: cert expiry 2026-03-19T23:59Z UTC. They rotated but pushed with an older cert by mistake.
rachel: That explains login failures. For SCIM extid, envelope mismatch suggests partner wrapped with different envelope version. We expect "redwood-kms-v1".
sre-ops: Quick mitigation: enable tenant-level relax on envelope required to log clearer errors, not to accept insecure envelopes. We can surface a better 400 and a detailed audit.
kira: Do not accept unknown envelopes silently. Add explicit error: "unsupported envelope version: please use redwood-kms-v1 (doc link)". Also add metric scim.extid.unsupported_envelope.
omar: I'll open SEC-2110 for parser validation + SEC-2111 for improved errors.
rachel: Helios ops replied: accidental config rollback on their side. They will rotate metadata and rewrap extids. ETA 2h.
sre-ops: I toggled alerting to include these metrics and will create a dashboard.
kira: For cert expiry, add check in onboarding that metadata cert expiry > 30d and an email reminder 7d before expiry. SEC-2112.
omar: Agreed. I'll draft onboarding checklist change.
rachel: TL;DR: Helios will resend; we added clearer error for unsupported envelope and an audit; added temporary monitoring. Will follow up with postmortem.
sre-ops: scim.create succeeded user=helios/bob req=req_bb34 note=extid-accepted
rachel: Closing — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
